title: CloudArtifactRepository single-stream download guard keyed on the SDK repo class name
answers: UC model download uses presigned URL and fails
parallel download broken for Databricks SDK model repo
why does _download_file skip multipart for models
model artifact download bypasses presigned URI
body:
Symptom: Downloading a UC model's files through the Files API fails or misbehaves when the multipart path is used.
Root cause: CloudArtifactRepository._download_file otherwise routes large files to _parallelized_download_from_cloud, which fetches presigned URIs that the SDK repo cannot use.
Fix pattern: _download_file adds an extra condition, type(self).__name__ == "DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository", that sends the download to _download_from_cloud, a single stream read in MLFLOW_MULTIPART_DOWNLOAD_CHUNK_SIZE chunks.
Constraints: The check matches the class name string, so renaming DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository silently re-enables presigned downloads. Any new Files-API repo needs the same guard or a cleaner override.
applies: CloudArtifactRepository._download_file and its subclasses; the other download conditions are unchanged.
says: Downloading large registered model files from Unity Catalog fails with an unexpected error.
Model artifact downloads fail when retrieving files through the workspace file interface.
Large model file downloads from catalog storage should use direct streaming instead of presigned links.
Multipart parallel file download breaks when retrieving model artifacts from catalog repositories.
Model checkpoint downloads fail because generated presigned storage addresses cannot be accessed.
search: CloudArtifactRepository._download_file routes DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository downloads to single-stream _download_from_cloud based on a class name string check. This guard prevents large Unity Catalog model downloads through the Files API from entering _parallelized_download_from_cloud and requesting unsupported presigned URIs. Downloads proceed in MLFLOW_MULTIPART_DOWNLOAD_CHUNK_SIZE chunks. Renaming DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository silently re-enables presigned downloads, and any new Files-API repository requires the same guard or override.
